cards.title: CAT ENTERTAINER
cards.concept: laughing village cat-sitter in a plain grey wool tunic, holding a small tabby kitten up in both hands at his chest, broad open-mouthed laugh with eyes crinkled shut
cards.hook: bio: 'professional cat entertainer', plus his huge joyful laugh

cards.title: APPLE PICKER
cards.concept: cheerful orchard hand in a grey linen shirt and leather shoulder strap, hugging a woven basket of apples to his chest with one apple held up proudly
cards.hook: engineering years at Apple, taken literally

cards.title: JOLLY INNKEEPER
cards.concept: beaming innkeeper in a grey apron over a dark shirt, raising a foaming tankard in a toast with a ring of room keys hanging at his chest
cards.hook: Airbnb alum, and the warmest host in any room

cards.title: TINKER APPRENTICE
cards.concept: grinning workshop apprentice in a scuffed grey leather apron, a wrench slung over one shoulder and a handful of brass gears held at his chest
cards.hook: engineer at heart before he was CTO

cards.title: LEDGER SCRIBE
cards.concept: good-humoured scribe in a grey hooded robe with the hood down, a quill tucked behind his ear and an armful of overflowing scrolls stacked against his chest
cards.hook: big data, back when data meant scrolls

cards.title: CAT RANGER
cards.concept: ranger in a green cloak with the hood down and leather bracers, a sly green-eyed cat familiar peeking over his shoulder and a green-fletched arrow held across his chest
cards.hook: professional cat entertainer, now with a trained partner

cards.title: ORCHARD WARDEN
cards.concept: sturdy warden in green-trimmed leather with an apple-wood staff behind his shoulder, a single bright apple in his palm and a tiny leaf sprite hovering near it
cards.hook: Apple, grown into a guardian of the orchard

cards.title: GEARWRIGHT
cards.concept: field artificer in a leather jerkin with green enamel buckles and magnifier lenses on a headband, a small clockwork owl familiar perched on his shoulder
cards.hook: hands-on engineer who builds the machines himself

cards.title: WAYFINDER
cards.concept: smiling travel guide in a green wayfarer's cloak, holding an unlit brass lantern and a rolled map at his chest with a key on a cord around his neck
cards.hook: Airbnb: finding every traveller a place to stay

cards.title: RUNE ENGINEER
cards.concept: seasoned rune engineer in a fitted dark coat with teal piping, brass goggles hanging around his neck so his short black hairline stays clear, raising a gauntlet etched with faintly glowing teal circuit-runes
cards.hook: engineering at Apple, where craft meets magic

cards.title: STARSTREAM DRUID
cards.concept: druid in dark robes with teal leaf embroidery, a ribbon of glowing teal starlight flowing between his cupped hands at chest height
cards.hook: big data at AWS and Airbnb, tended like a living forest

cards.title: PAWLADIN
cards.concept: laughing paladin in a teal-trimmed steel breastplate with a large cat-paw sigil embossed at its centre, a round shield bearing the same paw raised at one side and a faint teal shield-glow behind him
cards.hook: sworn protector of cats: the professional cat entertainer, knighted

cards.title: ARCHMAGE OF RUNES
cards.concept: archmage in ornate violet-and-black robes with a high collar, glowing violet rune-glyphs orbiting his head and a violet glow rising from his raised hands; broad open-mouthed laugh, eyes crinkled shut with joy, round face, short black hair
cards.hook: CTO: the one who writes the spells the whole company runs on

cards.title: STORM SHAPER
cards.concept: storm sorcerer in violet armour robes sculpting crackling magenta thunderclouds into floating crystal spires behind his shoulders, lightning in his raised hand; joyful open-mouthed laugh, eyes crinkled, round face, short black hair
cards.hook: AWS: he shapes the cloud itself

cards.title: STAR ASCENDANT
cards.concept: radiant ascended founder in gold-and-white regalia with a halo of golden starlight, a translucent benevolent cat-spirit of starlight sitting low behind his shoulders below the halo, and a glowing golden core cradled at his chest; joyful open-mouthed laugh, eyes crinkled, round face, short black hair, the laughing face the clear focal point
cards.hook: his stated passion for AGI, fused with his cats, in one mythic laughing form of pure starlight
